scope: V10 Year One Mine entrance only: timber portal, connected mortared shoulders and their visual integration on the existing Mine route. This pass does not cover surrounding terrain, Mountain, or other props.
author: Asset author

roles.asset_author: Produced, iterated and froze the candidate, ran real-engine measurements and authored this record. Did not independently approve the work.
roles.independent_render_reviewer: Separately inspected the matched hero, tactical, close, reverse and bidirectional LOD evidence; checked the exact candidate manifest, cost limits and gameplay regressions, then recorded the overall PASS for this prop only.

evidence.godot_context: Offline matched 1280×720 Mara hero and 116 m tactical views, unchanged campaign lighting and HUD. The V9 close stills are valid for V10 because the matching rendered close/front/reverse frames and generated close/caster arrays are identical.
evidence.close_up: Offline neutral joinery close-up and HUD-free close capture of the actual campaign map, checked against the same high-detail V10 geometry, textures and caster.
evidence.reproduction: Godot 4.7.2 GL Compatibility, 1280×720. Run game/battlefield/mara_mine_escort_campaign.tscn. Move the hero from the haul road toward the timber portal at (-63, 0, 57); pan near x=-70 to -58, z=50, look from inside the tunnel, and toggle Shift/L2 for the 116 m tactical sector. Matched cost fixture freezes the scene, frames hero at XZ (-64.65, 51.25) aimed at (-63, 57), and centers tactical camera at XZ (-63, 53), yaw -2.70 radians; original/candidate/candidate/original, 16 warm frames then 28 timed renders each.
evidence.motion: Offline 237-frame 24 fps, 9.875 s real Godot camera walkthrough, preserving the original view sequence and returning through the same LOD distances. Check 3.25–3.29 s retreat and 8.25–8.29 s approach; masonry/braces/crown stay visible and the smaller fittings drop together. Closing and opening poses are pixel-matched; no reverse hole observed.
evidence.measurements: Offline ABBA counters, decoded texture/geometry identity measurements, and six headless Mine/gameplay regressions. Exact evidence identities and quantitative limits below.

shape_and_craft.finding: Intended scale and silhouette keep the original opening. Mortared relief, hewn beam, bracing and banded fittings read as a mine portal from frontal and reverse playable angles.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Layered stone, baked contact joints, broken timber grain and localized iron wear remain distinct in the unchanged scene light. Scope is the entrance prop, not the flat surrounding cliff.

readability_in_play.finding: Same opening and approach in normal hero and tactical views. No objective, route or visibility-cue edits.

motion_and_effects.finding: Static prop checked in motion. Both LOD directions keep the baked stone atlas, braces and crown. Shared bounds keep the small hardware drop synchronized; no hole or old V9 masonry collapse.

integration_and_cost.finding: Exact reviewed files, clean import, unchanged collision and markers, six gameplay/terrain suites, and measured per-prop draw, rendered primitive, geometry and memory limits satisfied.

notes.scene_limits: 24 original box collision resources and 231 non-mesh marker and geometry nodes unchanged in the local comparison. The evacuation portal is unchanged.
notes.cost: Original → V10: hero 156 → 160 draws, 3,916 → 10,304 rendered primitives (+4/+6,388, limits +8/+7,000); tactical 184 → 181 draws, 7,604 → 7,856 primitives (−3/+252, limits +2/+256). 426,504 B raw geometry, 3,451,612 B mipped imported surface image data, 65,536 B decoded relief (limits 512 KiB / 4 MiB / 256 KiB).
notes.software_timing_limit: Mesa llvmpipe only. In pinned 2-CPU/2-thread repeat, software hero 113.04 → 139.74 ms (+23.6%) and tactical 106.09 → 113.51 ms (+7.0%), mean of two per-order medians. Unrestricted repeats varied under host contention; tactical software medians were higher in all paired runs. These are not console FPS or overall scene performance guarantees.
notes.provenance: Reproducible original authored Godot and Python/NumPy/Pillow sources. Offline captures and raw review logs are identified by digest, not included in the deliverable.
